title: The Life of George H. W. Bush — Who George H. W. Bush Really Was #Shorts
description:
The rise of George H. W. Bush was not an accident — in retrospect the pattern is plain. George Herbert Walker Bush (June 12, 1924 – November 30, 2018) was the 41st president of the United States, serving from 1989 to 1993. A member of the Republican Party, he served as the 43rd vice president under President Ronald Reagan.

Money, luck and timing all played their parts in the life of George H. W. Bush — in that order. Like most other Texas Republicans, Bush supported conservative Senator Barry Goldwater over the more centrist Nelson Rockefeller in the 1964 Republican Party presidential primaries. Bolstered by superior fundraising, Bush won the Republican primary by defeating former gubernatorial nominee Jack Cox in a run-off election.
